title: Variational Regularized Unbalanced Optimal Transport: Single Network, Least Action
tldr_zh: 把 RUOT 一阶最优性条件嵌入参数化与损失，单标量场求解，作用量更低、训练更快更稳
tldr_en: Embeds RUOT first-order optimality conditions into parameterization and loss; single scalar field solves RUOT with lower action and faster, more stable training
